assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story and classroom tool. ONE perfectly regular 3-column by 3-row atlas of nine separate original visitor portraits and props for an English lesson for first graders, wide cream gutters at exactly the thirds, equally sized cells. Each portrait is a warmly expressive waist-up front view of one person, all at the same scale, whole head and shoulders inside the cell, cream matte field. Consistent fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper silhouettes, quiet deep pine and warm cream with apricot and persimmon accents. Readable at 60 pixels. No text, numbers, blank signs, costumes, logos, jewelry clutter, or textbook characters. Read rows left to right. Row 1: (1) 7-year-old girl host, round teal glasses, black bob, pine cardigan; (2) her adult father, dark wavy hair, clean-shaven, rust v-neck sweater over cream shirt, friendly smiling; (3) her adult mother, short dark hair held back by a single plum headband, lavender top. Row 2: (4) her grandfather and her mother's father, same warm facial resemblance, short silver hair, silver moustache and dark pine vest; (5) her grandmother, silver bob hair and apricot cardigan, no glasses; (6) her friend, 7-year-old boy with a bright coral top, open palm waving and curly brown hair. Row 3: (7) other child host, 7-year-old boy with pale-blue overalls and short straight hair, no glasses; (8) that boy's father, grown man with dark navy shirt and blue cap, compact beard and open expression, clearly distinct from the rust-sweater father; (9) a single small pine-green toy delivery van in side profile, two wheels, rounded orange bumper, no cargo, text or logo. Separate assets, no object touches cell edges.
